claimContract: observable = f(geometry_state, architecture_state, scale_state, precision_state, measurement_operator)
claim: The published contextual-curvature operator has a comparable middle-layer profile and trajectory-aligned residual interventions couple curvature changes to next-token entropy more strongly than misaligned controls on the declared local model and prompts.
primaryObservable: Layerwise out-of-fold Pearson correlation between contextual curvature and next-token entropy, plus importance-weighted per-token Pearson correlation between intervention-induced delta curvature and delta entropy for five geometric arms.
explicitFalsifier: The local model lacks a middle-layer curvature/predictivity profile, or trajectory and planar arms do not separate from full-space, random-subspace, and activation-subspace controls under the frozen operator.

frozenSurfaces.precision: declared by model config and emitted at runtime
frozenSurfaces.targetLayerPolicy: minimum mean contextual curvature unless explicitly pre-registered
frozenSurfaces.importanceReference: full-space perturbations at the selected intervention layer; unlike paper appendix A.4, this first local packet does not pool across multiple intervention layers

comparisonBudget.tokens: all positions satisfying the cited position rule and intervention look-ahead

paper.title: Representational Curvature Modulates Behavioral Uncertainty in Large Language Models

minimumTokenPosition.source: King et al. 2026 section 2.4: positions n > 6

confidenceLevel.source: King et al. 2026 sections 2.5 and A.4

importanceWeightCap.source: King et al. 2026 appendix A.4: weights clamped to [1/tau, tau]

randomSeedPolicy: first 64 bits of the canonical source-manifest SHA-256 digest
ownerGate: Run on Apple Silicon with the declared model and probe inventory; compare qualitative profiles and document every discrepancy. Do not add VALIDATED-ENG or VALIDATED-EFF from this unreviewed packet.
